name: Cutly dependency and linked text-shape provider closure

creationInfo.comment: Reproducible source SBOM. The timestamp is the lock revision date, not a runtime build attestation. dependency-lock.json is the normative machine-readable reachability classifier.

packages.name: github.com/CutlyLab/Cutly
packages.comment: Current independently buildable Cutly source module. This SBOM is not an executable or signed release attestation.

packages.name: github.com/google/jsonschema-go
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) 2025 JSON Schema Go Project Authors
packages.comment: closure=current_test; reachability=test_import; linked_package_count=1. Imported only by Cutly conformance tests, never by current production packages.

packages.name: github.com/google/go-cmp
packages.comment: closure=current_module_graph_only; reachability=upstream_test; linked_package_count=0. Required by jsonschema-go's go.mod for its upstream tests; no go-cmp package is imported by Cutly tests or production packages.

packages.name: github.com/go-text/typesetting
packages.comment: closure=current_production; reachability=production_import; linked_package_count=8. Imported by Cutly's pinned shape-only static-glyf provider; this does not advertise final Text render capability.

packages.name: golang.org/x/image
packages.comment: closure=current_production_transitive; reachability=production_import; linked_package_count=3. Linked transitively through go-text font parsing. Upstream LICENSE and PATENTS bytes are locked.

packages.name: github.com/go-text/typesetting-utils
packages.comment: closure=current_module_graph_only; reachability=upstream_test_generate; linked_package_count=0. Upstream test/generation requirement only; no package is linked into the Cutly provider.

packages.name: golang.org/x/text
packages.comment: closure=current_module_graph_only; reachability=module_graph_only; linked_package_count=0. Selected by current MVS through x/image's go.mod, but no x/text package is in the production import closure. Upstream LICENSE and PATENTS bytes are locked.

packages.name: HarfBuzz source base
packages.comment: Embedded algorithm source base identified by commit 5a31dd02f0b32de12336f72db9297bfe94cf0da1 and ported inside go-text/typesetting v0.3.5; this is not a separate linked C library.
